title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Descrição da Empresa Somos uma concessionaria de caminhões .

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Analista Financeiro para integrar nossa equipe em Curitiba, PR. Este cargo implica em participar ativamente de atividades cotidianas relacionadas ao contas a receber, e à elaboração de relatórios. Entre as responsabilidades estão a análise de demonstrações financeiras, o suporte em estratégias de planejamento financeiro e o acompanhamento dos resultados da empresa para garantir a eficiência e sustentabilidade das operações. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer a presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Planejamento Financeiro: Experiência em planejamento financeiro para apoiar decisões estratégicas e operacionais dentro da empresa.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados financeiros detalhadamente para identificar tendências e apoiar análises críticas.
  • Conhecimento em Finanças: Domínio de práticas e princípios financeiros em geral que suportem o desempenho econômico da empresa.
  • Formação em administração, economia, contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas. Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise financeira e fluência em inglês serão considerados diferenciais.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.

Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);

E mais: Trabalho Híbrido.

  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

title: Javascript/React Software Developer - Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).
  • Contractor will issue monthly invoices for services rendered.
  • No employment relationship (CLT), and no employment benefits (transportation, vacation, 13th salary, etc.) are provided.
  • Flexible hours and autonomy in executing tasks, while meeting project deadlines and deliverables.

Keywords: Javascript, React, Node.js, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, Front-end, Back-end, Mobile (iOS/Android), React Native, Web Development, Software Development, R&D, Prototyping, QA, Algorithms, Engineering, Technology.

title: Strategic Distribution Partner - Brazil (Cardiology / Heart Failure)
description:
Acorai is preparing to expand into the Brazilian market and is seeking a best-in-class strategic distribution partner in Brazil to lead commercialization of its next-generation, non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring solution for heart failure care pathways.What we’re looking for

We’re interested in partnering with an established Brazilian medical device distributor/importer that can:

  • Drive adoption in cardiology/heart failure across key hospital networks
  • Provide clinical education & field support (KOL development, onboarding, workflow integration)
  • Handle service/logistics and post-market processes at hospital-grade standards
  • Navigate local commercialization realities (procurement, tenders where relevant, hospital committees)
What a partnership could look like
  • Territory: Brazil (exclusive potential)
  • Structure: Performance-based exclusivity with clear milestones
  • Launch approach: Pilot-site activation + clinical education + structured scale-up plan
  • Alignment: Long-term partnership orientation with shared execution focus
Who should reach out
  • Distributor principals / CEOs / GMs
  • Leaders of cardiology-focused distributor groups
  • Regional medtech operators with a strong hospital network and commercialization engine
Next steps

If this matches your organization, message us with:

  • Your company overview + therapeutic focus
  • Coverage footprint (cities/states) and sales/service organization
  • 2–3 examples of similar hospital-launched products you’ve scaled
  • Your view on a 6–12 month launch plan in Brazil

title: Bilingual Recruiter Assistant
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote

At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.

This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.

What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding

Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines

Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace

Build Your Career in Recruitment

If you want to work directly with U.S. teams, gain valuable recruiting experience, and grow fast in a structured and performance-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.

Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced
description:
Lead Data Architect – Azure Databricks & Advanced Analytics


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Architect with deep expertise in Azure Databricks and advanced analytics to design and deliver scalable, cloud-native data solutions. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills combined with architectural leadership to drive end-to-end analytics platforms aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in big data technologies, data engineering, and Azure cloud services, with a strong focus on Databricks, SQL, and modern data lakehouse architectures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective data solutions
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs, architectural standards, and best practices
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , and on-premise systems
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, fostering continuous learning and innovation
  • Ensure comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipelines, and data flows
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, data security, governance, and scalability
  • Stay current with evolving Databricks and Azure technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation


Essential Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop , and data processing frameworks like PySpark
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

O que te espera no dia a dia?

  • Realizar prospecção de clientes ;
  • Realizar venda do produto Crédito Pessoal;
  • Cadastrar as propostas no sistema e fechamento de contratos;
  • Atuar na retenção e fidelização de clientes.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas e metas;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.

Informações adicionais

Local de trabalho: Centro, Piedade (SP)

Jornada: 100% presencial

Horário de trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h

Remuneração:

Salário Fixo

Remuneração Variável

Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Plano odontológico MetLife;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Programa de Incentivo Educacional: Pagamos 100% da sua graduação, pós graduação, curso de idiomas ou cursos rápidos;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass) , uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.
  • Paceria com a plataforma da Psicologia Viva , em que você e seus dependentes conseguem fazer sessões de terapia 100% online e gratuito;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.

E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

- VB6

Atuar na manutenção e adequação de sistemas legados para o projeto CNPJ Alfanumérico, que consiste na adaptação do CNPJ do formato numérico para alfanumérico, em conformidade com as normativas vigentes do Banco Central.


Principais Responsabilidades


Realizar manutenção evolutiva e corretiva em sistemas legados desenvolvidos em VB6 e ASP Clássico;


Adequar regras de negócio e estruturas de dados para suportar o novo formato alfanumérico do CNPJ;


Atuar em ambientes de alta plataforma, garantindo performance, estabilidade e integridade das aplicações;

Documentar alterações técnicas e funcionais conforme padrões internos.

Habilidades Técnicas:


- ASP

- VB6

title: Strategic Distribution Partner – Brazil (Cardiology / Heart Failure)
description:
Acorai is preparing to expand into the Brazilian market and is seeking a best-in-class strategic distribution partner in Brazil to lead commercialization of its next-generation, non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring solution for heart failure care pathways.

What we’re looking for

We’re interested in partnering with an established Brazilian medical device distributor/importer that can:

  • Drive adoption in cardiology/heart failure across key hospital networks
  • Provide clinical education & field support (KOL development, onboarding, workflow integration)
  • Handle service/logistics and post-market processes at hospital-grade standards
  • Navigate local commercialization realities (procurement, tenders where relevant, hospital committees)
What a partnership could look like
  • Territory: Brazil (exclusive potential)
  • Structure: Performance-based exclusivity with clear milestones
  • Launch approach: Pilot-site activation + clinical education + structured scale-up plan
  • Alignment: Long-term partnership orientation with shared execution focus
Who should reach out
  • Distributor principals / CEOs / GMs
  • Leaders of cardiology-focused distributor groups
  • Regional medtech operators with a strong hospital network and commercialization engine
Next steps

If this matches your organization, message us with:

  • Your company overview + therapeutic focus
  • Coverage footprint (cities/states) and sales/service organization
  • 2–3 examples of similar hospital-launched products you’ve scaled
  • Your view on a 6–12 month launch plan in Brazil

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js/JavaScript) — E-commerce
description:
About firmly

firmly solutions turn moments of product discovery (AI, social, content, ads, messaging, etc.) into instant purchases through its agentic commerce platform — with fast, embedded checkout and a strong focus on security and reliability.

If you enjoy building high-performance APIs, working on distributed systems, and shipping cloud-native solutions with real-world scale and constraints, you’ll fit right in.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve backend services and APIs in Node.js/JavaScript for critical e-commerce/checkout flows.
  • Develop edge/serverless systems on Cloudflare Workers (e.g., Workers and related services) focused on low latency, resilience, and scalability.
  • Design and implement partner integrations (APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows) and near real-time data sync (e.g., pricing, inventory, order status).
  • Improve observability (logs/metrics/tracing), incident readiness, and operational excellence (“you build it, you run it”).
  • Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD improvements, and pragmatic architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Partnerships, Data) and contribute as a technical leader/mentor within the team.

Required skills & experience

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer building production-grade backends with Node.js/JavaScript.
  • Solid experience designing and operating APIs (REST and/or event-driven systems) with a quality mindset.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Workers (Workers and other services) OR strong serverless/edge background and willingness to go deep on Cloudflare.
  • Good foundation in data modeling and databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) for transactional systems.
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals (authN/authZ, secrets management, least privilege, secure-by-default design).
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) — you’ll collaborate with a global team and participate in meetings/doc reviews in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with payments, checkout, fraud/risk, or other mission-critical e-commerce systems.
  • Event-driven architectures, async processing, queues/streams.
  • Performance/latency optimization, caching, edge patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Cloudflare Workers tooling (Wrangler); plus modern DevOps practices.

Benefits & Career Growth

  • Unimed Nacional health plan (coverage for spouse/partner and children).
  • Meal and food allowance (VR/VA).
  • Life insurance.
  • UniOdonto dental plan.
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities (mentorship, ownership, and room to grow with the team).
  • Clear growth path (regular feedback and performance cycles).
  • Ownership & autonomy (high-impact work, end-to-end responsibility).
  • Learning & development support.

How to apply

Click Easy Apply on LinkedIn and attach your resume (PDF).

  • Tip: parts of the interview process may be conducted in English.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for \"Full Stack Developer\" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor React & JavaScript Vanilla Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Frontend Pleno com foco em React e JavaScript Vanilla para atuar na construção e evolução de aplicações web escaláveis e de alto impacto. O conhecimento em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) é um diferencial , mas caso ainda não tenha tido contato, é importante ter interesse em aprender e evoluir nessa stack.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces web com React e JavaScript Vanilla
  • Criar interações diretas manipulando o DOM quando necessário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST
  • Construir componentes reutilizáveis com foco em performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e discussões de solução
  • Atuar em code reviews e apoiar na qualidade do código do time
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, com comunicação clara


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência com React e JavaScript
  • Domínio de React: hooks, estado, componentização e performance
  • Forte base em JavaScript Vanilla: DOM, eventos e consumo de APIs sem frameworks
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo
  • Autonomia, foco e organização
  • Conhecimento em HTML semântico e CSS moderno
  • Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com AEM, caso ainda não tenha experiência


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com AEM (Adobe Experience Manager)


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Técnico de telecomunicações
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global. Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Perfil: Técnico Telecom

Jornada de Trabalho: Segunda a Sexta - 07:00 às 16:00 (Necessário disponibilidade para plantão mediante escala e regime de sobre aviso após horário)

Local de trabalho: Rodovia Do Sol - Município: Anchieta.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar na implantação, operação e manutenção de soluções de telecomunicações.
  • Executar atividades de cabeamento estruturado, incluindo passagem, organização e certificação.
  • Realizar passagem, fusão e conectorização de fibra óptica.
  • Montar, organizar e realizar a arrumação de racks, garantindo padronização e qualidade.
  • Configurar e operar switches e access points Cisco, conforme projetos e padrões técnicos.
  • Operar e dar suporte a equipamentos de telefonia, PABX e videoconferência.
  • Acompanhar, controlar e inspecionar a execução de projetos de telecom, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, escopo e normas técnicas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, avaliando projetos e propondo melhorias técnicas quando necessário.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam em conformidade com as normas técnicas de telecomunicações.
  • Apoiar equipes técnicas e fornecedores durante as execuções em campo.
  • Participar de plantões em escala e atuar em regime de sobreaviso quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo nas ares de Tecnologia da Informação, Telecomunicações, Redes de Computadores, Engenharia de Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas
  • Ter conhecimento especifico do funcionamento dos equipamentos CISCO.

O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.

Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.

Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).

Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.

After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.

We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Video Editor
description:
If you’re interested, please complete your application here: only applications submitted through this form will be considered.


At Carbinox , we build rugged, durable, and affordable smartwatches for the U.S. market. Our products are designed for people who work hard and demand reliability. With a fast growing customer base and performance driven marketing, video content plays a critical role in how we grow, connect, and convert.


We are looking for a Video Editor  who understands ecommerce, storytelling, and short form content that drives results.


Position We Are Hiring For

We are hiring a full time Video Editor  focused on creating high impact video content for Instagram, TikTok, and ecommerce marketing .


This is a long term, in house role , not freelance or contract. You will be a core part of our marketing team and contribute directly to brand growth and performance.


Job Expectations

You will be responsible for creating engaging, conversion focused video content that aligns with our brand and marketing goals.

This includes:

  • Editing and producing high quality videos  for:

Social media (Instagram and TikTok)

Organic brand content

Ecommerce marketing

  • Transforming raw footage into polished, scroll stopping content
  • Researching and applying:

Current trends

Creative angles

Storytelling formats that perform

  • Creating organic style videos  that resonate with our audience
  • Enhancing videos using:

Strong composition

Lighting awareness

Motion graphics and effects when needed

  • Staying up to date with short form video trends  and best practices

Your work will directly impact engagement, brand presence, and performance .


Basic Requirements

  • Full time availability
  • Fluent in English and Spanish
  • Proven experience creating video content for DTC or ecommerce brands
  • Strong skills in:

Video editing

Visual storytelling

Composition and pacing

  • Solid understanding of:

Instagram and TikTok content strategies

Organic video performance

  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Organized, proactive, and solutions driven mindset


Our Core Behaviors

At Carbinox, culture matters as much as performance. We work based on these five Core Behaviors:

  • Create progress, do not wait for it
  • Take ownership of absolutely everything
  • Be reachable and keep work moving
  • Honor the balance and turn it into impact
  • Do what you say, when you say you will

We are looking for someone who naturally lives these values.


What We Offer

  • 100% remote work
  • Full time, long term position
  • A fast growing ecommerce brand with real scale
  • A performance driven environment where your work truly matters
  • A culture built on ownership, trust, and execution
  • The opportunity to create content that reaches and impacts thousands of customers

Acelerador de Agilidade - Remoto

Você atuará como facilitador(a) e agente de transformação ágil em times multidisciplinares, apoiando a evolução da maturidade ágil, a melhoria contínua e a entrega de valor em ambientes de alta complexidade tecnológica.

  • Experiência em times ágeis de desenvolvimento, testes, suporte, infraestrutura e manutenção

  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, SAFe, ICP-ACC, entre outras)

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Representante comercial de vendas
description:
Representante de Vendas – Food Service | Utilidades Profissionais e Domésticas

Chef Line Inox

Sobre a Chef Line

A Chef Line é uma marca e importadora de utilidades domésticas e institucionais, com forte atuação no segmento de food service.

Nosso portfólio inclui utensílios de cozinha para preparo e serviço, cutelaria, opaline, talheres, cubas GN, botijões térmicos, cafeteiras elétricas, panelas aquecedoras, réchauds elétricos e a fogareiro, além de outros produtos profissionais, com certificação Inmetro quando aplicável e garantia.

Desde 2017, fornecemos soluções para cozinhas profissionais em todo o Brasil.

Escritório em Itajaí (SC) e Centro de Distribuição em São José (SC), com entrega nacional.

Atendemos atacados, distribuidores, lojistas, supermercados e canais de marketplace, com portfólio de alto giro.

Contamos com política de parcelamento, frete CIF para diversas regiões, equipe interna dedicada e aplicativo próprio para gestão de pedidos e informações de produto.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos contratando Representantes de Vendas para todos os estados do Brasil.

  • Atuação com região definida, conforme alinhamento comercial.
  • Regime de remuneração: comissionamento

Responsabilidades

  • Comercializar o portfólio Chef Line para o mercado profissional
  • Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes
  • Realizar visitas e atendimento à carteira ativa
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais
  • Gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes
  • Acompanhar pedidos, pós-venda e relacionamento comercial
  • Utilizar as ferramentas e o aplicativo da empresa no dia a dia comercial

Qualificações

  • Experiência em vendas externas ou representação comercial
  • CNPJ ativo para representação
  • Carteira de clientes ativos
  • Não atuar com pastas conflitantes
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e focado em relacionamento comercial

title: Observability Engineer - PL/SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Observability Engineer – PL/SR para atuar no desenho, implementação e operação de soluções de observabilidade, garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta dos ambientes, aplicações e serviços em arquiteturas híbridas e multicloud.

Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e manter pipelines de telemetria para logs, métricas e traces ;
  • Desenvolver e operar a infraestrutura responsável pela coleta, processamento e roteamento de dados de observabilidade;
  • Arquitetar, implementar e operar a plataforma de observabilidade baseada no Grafana Stack ;
  • Integrar soluções de observabilidade em ambientes híbridos e multicloud , suportando diferentes tipos de workloads;
  • Trabalhar com ambientes containerizados e orquestrados com Kubernetes ;
  • Integrar observabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps ;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de plataforma, SRE e desenvolvimento para evolução contínua das soluções.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência com Grafana Stack (arquitetura, implementação e operação);
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de observabilidade (Logs, Metrics e Traces);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) e GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota o fuso horário de Portugal

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenTelemetry;
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em SRE ou engenharia de confiabilidade.

title: Analista tributário
description:
A Oliveira & Carvalho busca Analista Tributário e Previdenciário para compor seu time.

Somos uma consultoria tributária com uma cultura dinâmica, exigente e orientada a resultados. Investimos de forma consistente no desenvolvimento das pessoas e oferecemos espaço real para profissionais responsáveis, comprometidos e com vontade de fazer acontecer crescerem junto com a empresa.

Nosso ambiente é colaborativo, porém de alta responsabilidade. A atuação em home office exige disciplina, resiliência, maturidade profissional e dedicação. Aqui, a confiança está diretamente ligada à qualidade das entregas, ao cumprimento de prazos e ao comprometimento com resultados.

Requisitos:

Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas ou Direito.

Experiência com revisão e execução de procedimentos fiscais relacionadas à escrituração fiscal e apurações de ICMS, ICMS-ST, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL e PIS/COFINS cumulativos e não cumulativos e análise e conferência de documentação do cliente conforme o checklist para execução do projeto.

Domínio das obrigações acessórias para operacionalização e aproveitamento de créditos, tais como SPED FISCAL, EFD- Contribuições, ECD, ECF, DCTF e PER/DCOMP.

Atuação com impostos diretos e indiretos.

Conhecimento em empresas de Lucro presumido, real e simples nacional.

Necessário disponibilidade para atuação em demandas previdenciárias, se necessário.

Competências Necessárias:

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade, com resiliência para lidar com prazos e demandas simultâneas. É fundamental possuir maturidade profissional para atuação remota, com disciplina, proatividade e foco em resultados. Valorizamos o comprometimento com a qualidade técnica e interesse genuíno em desenvolvimento contínuo.

Contrato: CLT

Remuneração: A combinar

Benefícios:

VR/VA no valor de R$30,00 por dia

Previdência Privada Opcional

Seguro de vida em Grupo

Plano de saúde 50%

Plano odontológico 50%

Regime: Home Office.

Local: Brasil

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Analytics & AI Lab, um squad multifuncional responsável por desenvolver algoritmos avançados e soluções de IA aplicadas a dados de retail media e comércio.

O squad atua como uma unidade de P&D e IA aplicada, construindo algoritmos que são:

  • alimentados por múltiplas fontes internas de dados;
  • expostos por meio de APIs;
  • consumidos por produtos, times de analytics e stakeholders de negócio.

Todo o ecossistema é construído sobre a Google Cloud Platform, com forte integração entre engenharia de dados, analytics engineering e desenvolvimento de IA.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Scientist, sua missão será desenhar, desenvolver e operacionalizar algoritmos de machine learning e IA que gerem valor de negócio em contextos de retail media. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analytics engineers, data engineers e times de produto para transformar dados brutos em soluções preditivas, prescritivas e inteligentes, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e explicabilidade.



Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de IA & Machine Learning

  • Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos de machine learning e algoritmos de IA;
  • Conduzir P&D de algoritmos de IA, da fase exploratória até soluções prontas para produção;
  • Selecionar abordagens de modelagem adequadas (estatísticas, ML, deep learning) conforme o problema de negócio.

Dados & Feature Engineering

  • Consumir dados do BigQuery e de camadas analíticas curadas;
  • Definir e criar features em parceria com os times de analytics e engenharia de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, relevância e consistência dos dados para modelagem.

Implantação e Integração de Modelos

  • Empacotar modelos e algoritmos para exposição via APIs;
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para implantação em ambientes produtivos;
  • Monitorar performance dos modelos, drift e necessidades de reentreinamento.

Casos de Uso em Retail Media

  • Desenvolver modelos relacionados a:
  • previsão de demanda;
  • performance de campanhas;
  • atribuição e uplift;
  • tráfego e conversão;
  • segmentação de audiências;
  • Traduzir KPIs de retail media e e-commerce em soluções orientadas por ML.

Colaboração & Trabalho em Squad

  • Atuar em um squad multicultural (Brasil + França), com comunicação diária em inglês;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com discussões técnicas, documentação e compartilhamento de conhecimento dentro do laboratório.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência com Python para data science e ML;
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de machine learning (supervisionados, não supervisionados, séries temporais etc.);
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados utilizando BigQuery;
  • Forte base em estatística e desenho experimental;
  • Experiência em expor modelos via APIs ou integrá-los a sistemas em produção.

Google Cloud & Stack de IA

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform;
  • Familiaridade com:
  • Vertex AI;
  • BigQuery ML;
  • Gemini / ferramentas de GenAI (prompting, embeddings, RAG ou similares);
  • Experiência com notebooks e fluxos de experimentação.



Habilidades Profissionais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidade para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de data science;
  • Excelente comunicação;
  • Inglês avançado (uso diário obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou retail media;
  • Experiência com práticas de MLOps (versionamento, monitoramento, reentreinamento);
  • Vivência em AI Labs ou squads de P&D;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de experimentação e testes A/B;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Forte autonomia e senso de ownership;
  • Confortável em ambientes exploratórios e com problemas ambíguos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar por meio de expertise técnica, não por hierarquia;
  • Perfil curioso, experimental e orientado a negócio.

title: Salesforce Developer (Healthcare & Data Cloud)
description:
Salesforce Developer (Healthcare & Data Cloud)


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


The Salesforce Developer will design, build, and optimize solutions across Salesforce Core, Healthcare and Life Sciences Cloud, and Data Cloud for a United States–based online pharmacy. This role collaborates closely with architects, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions that support prescription intake, benefits verification, refills, patient outreach, and contact center operations. The developer applies a configuration-first mindset and strong critical reasoning to determine the most effective balance between declarative tools and custom development.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Implement business functionality using Salesforce declarative tools such as Flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, and OmniScripts where appropriate;
  • Develop clean, scalable, and maintainable Apex classes, triggers, and batch processes when custom logic is required;
  • Build Lightning Web Components and console customizations to support pharmacy operations and patient support workflows;
  • Configure and support Salesforce Data Cloud data streams, data model objects, and calculated insights for patient 360 views and segmentation;
  • Implement Data Cloud activation patterns that drive actionable automation, queues, and outreach processes within Salesforce;
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of integrations with external systems using REST APIs, platform events, and middleware solutions;
  • Ensure all solutions are bulk-safe, performant, secure, and aligned with Salesforce coding standards and best practices;
  • Support testing and validation efforts by providing technical guidance on test coverage, traceability, and root cause analysis of defects.

Essential Skills


  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience using Apex, Lightning, and declarative tools;
  • Proven experience working with complex Salesforce data models, integrations, and performance optimization;
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as healthcare or pharmacy, including concepts related to PHI handling;
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate multiple implementation approaches and clearly communicate tradeoffs;
  • High attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to deliver maintainable, testable, and well-documented solutions;
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions within Healthcare and Life Sciences Cloud environments;
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a highly regulated domain;
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and data governance best practices within Salesforce.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


The Salesforce Developer will design, build, and optimize solutions across Salesforce Core, Healthcare and Life Sciences Cloud, and Data Cloud for a United States–based online pharmacy. This role collaborates closely with architects, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions that support prescription intake, benefits verification, refills, patient outreach, and contact center operations. The developer applies a configuration-first mindset and strong critical reasoning to determine the most effective balance between declarative tools and custom development.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Implement business functionality using Salesforce declarative tools such as Flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, and OmniScripts where appropriate;
  • Develop clean, scalable, and maintainable Apex classes, triggers, and batch processes when custom logic is required;
  • Build Lightning Web Components and console customizations to support pharmacy operations and patient support workflows;
  • Configure and support Salesforce Data Cloud data streams, data model objects, and calculated insights for patient 360 views and segmentation;
  • Implement Data Cloud activation patterns that drive actionable automation, queues, and outreach processes within Salesforce;
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of integrations with external systems using REST APIs, platform events, and middleware solutions;
  • Ensure all solutions are bulk-safe, performant, secure, and aligned with Salesforce coding standards and best practices;
  • Support testing and validation efforts by providing technical guidance on test coverage, traceability, and root cause analysis of defects.

  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience using Apex, Lightning, and declarative tools;

description:
About the job

Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time

About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.

  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack
  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background
  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours

How to Apply

Apply here:

  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Especialista em Análise de Dados
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Alinhar a estratégia de dados aos objetivos do negócio, priorizando iniciativas de alto impacto e geração de valor.
  • Liderar projetos analíticos complexos, com desenvolvimento de modelos avançados e visualizações analíticas de alto nível.
  • Atuar como referência técnica na área de dados, promovendo boas práticas e capacitando usuários para garantir autonomia analítica e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas, com experiência profissional entre 5 e 7 anos.
  • Sólida atuação em ambientes Cloud, pipelines de ETL complexos e otimização de consultas em SQL e Python, com perfil multiplicador de conhecimento.
  • Expertise avançada em ferramentas de BI e evolução de arquiteturas de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança e comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir análises técnicas em insights claros para stakeholders de negócio.


Nossos benefícios:


  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Auxílio Farmácia;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);
  • Bônus Anual

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei profissional de desenvolvimento, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Atuação com desenvolvimento Java (versões mais atuais).
  • Experiência com ecossistema SpringBoot .
  • Necessário conhecimento AWS Services (ECS, EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda, Kafka, DynamoDB ou similar, CI/CD, entre outros).
  • Experiência com testes utilizando JUnit, Mockito, entre outros...
  • Familiaridade com estrutura de microsserviços .
  • Desejável conhecimento em ambiente financeiro, PIX e/ou cobrança .

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
