Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.

We are currently looking for a Salesforce Release Manager to work in a Remote position for a 6+ month with possible extension job opportunity.

Job Title: Salesforce Release Manager

Location: Remote in LATAM

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 + months with possible extensions

  • Acts as the liaison between Product Owners and Salesforce development teams
  • Ensures user stories are complete, tested, approved, and ready for release

Nossa atuação é voltada para oferecer soluções jurídicas estratégicas, com foco em resultados, organização e proximidade com nossos clientes. Contato direto com os clientes do escritório;

Cobrança de documentos,

Organização de pastas;

Pesquisas de jurisprudências;

Auxiliar na gestão de demandas;

Colaborar em pesquisas jurídicas e estratégicas.

Perfil proativo, organizado e comunicativo;

Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Vontade de aprender e crescer na área jurídica;

Conhecimentos intermediário em informática (Word, Excel e Google Drive).

Conhecimento no sistema jurídico ADVBOX;

Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;

Estudar no período noturno.

Bolsa estágio no valor de R$ 1.000,00 (hum mil reais);

Bônus por produtividade;

Ambiente inovador, colaborativo e focado em resultados;

Oportunidade real de aprendizado prático;

Plano de carreira sólido.


  • Como se candidatar:


Aplique diretamente pelo LinkedIn.


No CNRA, não buscamos apenas estagiários. Buscamos futuros advogados empreendedores que querem viver a advocacia de verdade!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.

title: I'm looking for a Part-Time or Full-Time Executive Assistant & Appointment Setter (Bilingual - Brazil Based - $3-$6/hour))
description:
We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support a US-based dating coach and entrepreneur. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with a founder while also playing a vital role in a proven outreach system that helps clients improve their dating lives.


This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, bilingual (English and Portuguese), based in Brazil, and has a friendly and professional communication style. You’ll be managing essential administrative tasks while also handling Instagram-based outreach as part of the coach’s client acquisition strategy.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct daily Instagram outreach (DM-based) following a set script and strategy
  • Act as a virtual appointment setter, booking discovery calls with potential clients
  • Manage the founder's calendar and ensure appointments are scheduled efficiently
  • Organize and respond to business emails professionally and promptly
  • Perform light administrative work as needed (e.g. document organization, reminders, basic task tracking)


Ideal Candidate

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and Portuguese
  • Based in Brazil (required)
  • Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively
  • Familiar with Instagram and basic social media tools
  • Experience with appointment setting, lead generation, or executive assistance is a plus
  • Professional, reliable, and eager to grow with the role


Details

  • Position: Executive Assistant & Appointment Setter
  • Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (flexible options available)
  • Pay: $3–$6 USD/hour (based on experience and performance)
  • Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)
  • Timezone: Must be able to overlap partially with US time zones

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

title: Auxiliar Técnico (Motoboy)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuar como Motoboy (Auxiliar Técnico) em um dos nossos Corners - Região da Zona Sul - Socorro SP .

Sobre a Função

Essa vaga é para trabalhar com entrega e retirada de máquinas de cartão da Getnet, não realizamos venda. Não é preciso experiência, e oferecemos todos os treinamentos.

Responsabilidades

  • Execução de Ordens de Serviço (Instalação, Manutenção, Retirada e Substituição de Tecnologia de Máquinas, Chips, Bobinas, etc.) por meio de motocicletas;
  • Priorização de OSs (modalidade x lead time);
  • Otimização da rota a ser executada;
  • Conferência de máquinas expedidas e reversas;
  • Ativação de máquinas;
  • Manuseio e conferência de documentação (OSs, protocolos de atendimento, etc.);
  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Participação das reuniões de alinhamento da equipe com a liderança.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Moto da empresa;
  • Extrato de multas;
  • Documentação do condutor: CNH com habilitação categoria “A” com EAR válida.

Faixa de Pagamento e Pacote de Compensação

Salário: Compatível com Mercado Periculosidade + Remuneração variável é o valor por cada ordem de atendimento finalizada.

Benefícios:

Para sua saúde, oferecemos assistência médica e odontológica, para você e seus dependentes

title: Consultor Funcional de Dados - Arquitetura de Modelagem e Governança
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Funcional de Dados, com forte atuação em arquitetura de modelagem, governança de métricas e contextos, para atuar em um ambiente financeiro de alta criticidade e exigência técnica. A posição requer sólida visão de dados, atenção às regras de negócio e capacidade de estruturar camadas analíticas confiáveis, seguras e governadas.

O(a) profissional será responsável por estruturar e sustentar a camada semântica e de governança de dados, garantindo consistência de métricas, controle de acessos, padronização das regras de negócio e suporte ao modelo de self-service BI das áreas de negócio. Atuará de forma próxima a times técnicos e gestores com alto nível de exigência, sendo fundamental postura profissional, domínio conceitual e clareza na comunicação.

title: German Translator - Localization Specialist
description:
We are currently looking for a German Localization Specialist to join our global team.


Your work is to provide localization services for the short commands/data sets by verifying the correctness of the grammatical/pronunciation of the provided linguistic data sets. The tasks may include voice recording, adjustments of the data set in a software tool, transcription of the provided data set, and other work related to localizing the provided content.


The above description encapsulates the process referred to as “ Prompt Tuning.” When Prompt Tuning is performed, it requires actual native speakers to do the work, as their accent would be that of someone who grew up in the targeted country, spoke the local language as a first language, and is acquainted with the speech as spoken currently in a country of interest every day.


Experience:

Experience is important, but it's less about the years of experience and more about the skill set. However, a technical background is preferred (basic knowledge of, e.g., Notepad++, UX, Python, HTML, etc.). We are interested in people who can perform various tasks, but one of the important ones is Prompt Tuning. This requires excellent listening skills.


Requirements:

Having experience in localization is beneficial, and a background in linguistics is preferred.


Work Load:

The weekly workload will vary depending on the task. Sometimes, there will be 20 hours per week for several weeks, and later, another task will require 2 hours/week. It is on a project-by-project basis.


Training:

Full training will be provided, and our project team will guide you through the process.


Rate:

$13.75 per hour

title: PE Deal Origination Associate
description:
Caprae Capital Partners


Caprae Capital Partners is a next-generation private equity and venture platform built by operators, not career financiers. Led by founder Kevin Hong , a serial tech entrepreneur who has scaled companies to $31M ARR and $7M in revenue , Caprae was formed alongside fellow entrepreneurs who have achieved eight-figure and nine-figure exits (including acquisitions by Twitter and Square ). The broader partner network includes a former NASA software engineer and a former Chief of Staff at Google, a team engineered for innovation and disruption.


Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae

Caprae Capital Partners is a next-generation private equity and venture platform built by operators, not career financiers. Led by founder Kevin Hong , a serial tech entrepreneur who has scaled companies to $31M ARR and $7M in revenue , Caprae was formed alongside fellow entrepreneurs who have achieved eight-figure and nine-figure exits (including acquisitions by Twitter and Square ). The broader partner network includes a former NASA software engineer and a former Chief of Staff at Google, a team engineered for innovation and disruption.


Since launching in 2025, Caprae has already closed over $50M in transaction value , with $80M+ across its ecosystem , and an additional $60M scheduled to close by Q1 2026 . The company has been growing 20%+ MoM for 12 months, and this trend is expected to continue for the next several months.


Caprae is rethinking how entrepreneurship, capital, and talent connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move aggressively. This is not a traditional finance firm.


Caprae is redefining how entrepreneurship and capital connect. We operate at the intersection of private equity, venture operations, and founder enablement, and we move fast.


Role Description


We’re looking for a PE Deal Origination Associate with a sharp mind, strong communication skills, and the drive to turn conversations into real deals.


This is a full-time, front-line role for someone exceptional at cold outreach, confident presenting to executives, and energized by building pipeline from scratch. You’ll be on the front lines of growth—initiating conversations, building relationships with business owners, and helping convert opportunities into closed transactions across Caprae’s platform and portfolio.

This is not a passive sales or research role. You’ll learn how private equity actually works by doing it.

Responsibilites

  • Conduct high-volume, high-quality cold outreach (up to ~20 hours per week)
  • Book meetings with founders, CEOs, and business owners across industries
  • Support and, over time, lead sales and deal conversations
  • Help craft and deliver compelling narratives around Caprae’s offerings
  • Work closely with senior leadership to prioritize and pursue high-value opportunities
  • Track, manage, and report on outreach pipeline, meetings, and conversion metrics
  • Assist in select account management and client success conversations post-close
  • Contribute to brand positioning, investor relations, and PR initiatives as needed


What we look for

  • Strong cold-calling and outbound communication skills—clear, confident, and concise
  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and building rapport quickly
  • Highly motivated, autonomous, and performance-driven
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Strong interest in entrepreneurship, private equity, or finance
  • Finance education strongly preferred
  • Must be strong with numbers —this is not a fluff role


Culture Fit

We strongly prefer recent graduates or early-career candidates .

This role is ideal for smart, hungry, coachable people who want to learn private equity from the ground up . Traditional finance experience is not required - and in some cases, too much institutional experience (investment banking, rigid PE or sales orgs) can be a downside due to baked-in habits.

We care more about judgment, work ethic, and output than pedigree.


Career Growth

This role is built for rapid advancement . High performers can be promoted to Manager-level responsibility in months, not years , with ownership over pipeline, junior teammates, and meaningful deal flow. Compensation scales aggressively with performance. In addition to a competitive base salary, top performers earn absurd bonuses tied directly to deal closes and conversion , not tenure or politics. If you consistently originate high-quality opportunities and help close transactions, your total compensation can quickly outpace traditional entry-level finance and consulting roles .

This is a meritocratic environment: output → trust → responsibility → compensation .


Compensation

  • Competitive base salary
  • Generous commissions for each qualified meeting and deal closed
  • Absurd upside on deal closes for top performers
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to output and conversion
  • Fast-track growth into Manager, leadership, or platform roles within Caprae

title: Mainframe Project  Manager
description:
Job Description: Mainframe Project Manager – Remote

Location: LATAM

Rate: DOE


Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Manager to lead and oversee complex mainframe projects, ensuring successful execution and seamless integration with business processes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies , including zOS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX, and SAS , along with a strong background in project management, stakeholder management, risk assessment, and cost optimization . This role requires exceptional leadership skills to inspire teams, build relationships with stakeholders, and drive process improvements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, define project scope, set realistic timelines, and manage resources effectively.
  • Utilize expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies , including subsystems, JCL, COBOL, and REXX .
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end users .
  • Conduct risk assessments, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
  • Efficiently allocate resources, track expenses, and optimize costs while ensuring project success.
  • Provide leadership to project teams, fostering collaboration and setting clear direction.
  • Oversee project execution, ensuring alignment with defined project plans and timelines.
  • Maintain effective communication channels, manage stakeholder expectations, and address concerns promptly.
  • Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and ensure seamless vendor collaboration.
  • Assess the impact of mainframe migration on existing processes and workflows, ensuring smooth transitions.
  • Drive process improvements and implement best practices for change management .


Mandatory Skills and Proficiency Requirements:


  • zOS, AS400 – Advanced proficiency in mainframe operating systems.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX – Strong working knowledge of mainframe languages, job control, and scripting.
  • Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) – Demonstrated expertise in structured project management methodologies.
  • Project Management & Stakeholder Management – Strong ability to manage large-scale projects and engage with stakeholders effectively.
  • Risk Management & Vendor Relationship Management – Ability to assess and mitigate risks while maintaining vendor collaborations.
  • Change Management & Process Improvements – Proficiency in implementing change management strategies and driving process enhancements.
  • Team Management – Strong leadership skills to mentor, guide, and motivate technical teams.


Optional Skills and Proficiency Levels:

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL – Experience in database management on mainframe environments.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting – Experience in managing project finances, optimizing costs, and resource planning.

title: GenAI Data Scientist
description:
Job Details:

Job Title: GenAI Data Scientist

Exp- Minimum 8 years

  • 100% remote/Long Term Contract/EST hrs.


Job Role-

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will translate the needs of our cross-functional stakeholders into user-facing applications that leverage NLP techniques and large language models (LLMs). As a Sr. Data Scientist on our GenAI applications team, you will work on products like conversational search interfaces, chatbots, text summarizers, recommender engines, and more based on the needs of the constituents. You will partner with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, and cross-functional partners to develop production-grade algorithms.

You will contribute to the creation, delivery, and production of specific data science, machine learning and AI products for internal stakeholders; directly mentor other data professionals, data analysts, and machine learning engineers. In conjunction with the key partners, you will make technical decisions on data, technology, and ways of working

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Architect the overall framework and infrastructure for GenAI products like search interfaces, bots, summarizers, etc. Develop and implement techniques to optimize model performance to meet specific product goals
  • Collaborate closely with product management and engineering leads to align on technical roadmap. Guide engineering teams to effectively leverage LLM capabilities in product implementation.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation and business value. Proactively analyze latest developments in large language models to deeply understand model capabilities, limitations, and best practices. Develop techniques to continually improve language understanding and model training
  • Mentor and develop junior data scientists in state-of-the-art GenAI methods
  • Set technical vision and lead initiatives to accelerate product impact through cutting-edge LLM innovations
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Total Exp: 8 to 10yrs+
  • Advanced degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, statistics, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience in developing machine learning models with a track record of creating meaningful business impact and working with multiple stakeholders.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience with Python.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience building production NLP and deep learning models using PyTorch/Tensorflow, along with using large language model architectures (BERT, GPT-3 etc.)
  • Experience building advanced workflows such as retrieval augmented generation, model chaining, dynamic prompting, PEFT/SFT, etc. using Langchain and similar tools
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications
  • Proficiency with various prompting techniques, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs between prompting and finetuning
  • Experience with finetuning embedding models and tuning vector databases to improve performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Deep understanding of underlying fundamentals such as Transformers, Self-Attention mechanisms that form the theoretical foundation of LLMs
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms and tools (AWS).
  • Experience operationalizing end-to-end machine learning applications.

Empresa

A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.

title: Senior IT Technical Customer Support - English Advanced -
description:
What a Day In The Life Looks Like


  • Utilize active listening, empathy, and other emotional intelligent skills to properly handle customer interactions.
  • Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software.
  • Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to ERP Vendor, Honeywell/Vocollect, RF Hardware Provider, Seagull Scientific, Bartender, Georgia Softworks, or other third parties.
  • Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments.
  • Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of cloud solutions.
  • SQL performance monitoring / index and query tuning.
  • Meet or exceed defined customer service satisfaction scores and meet SLAs for initial response and issue resolution.
  • Maintain clear, concise communication with customers and internal teams. Accurately document all relevant information in the ticketing system.
  • Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams, external partners, and vendors. Proactively escalate tickets when necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • API endpoints and confirm.


What You Bring To The Team


  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of technical customer support experience.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Google, etc.).
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and self-manage.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory


You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With


  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)

title: Web Designer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

*Experience writing and manipulating HTML

* Proficient in English, attentive to industry standards, and equipped with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficient with Figma for prototyping, sharing/testing designs

* Experience with utilizing a Design System

* Experience with front-end testing

*Experience working within a CMS to build webpages with components


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

*Experience in Adobe Creative suite (Photoshop)

* Experience contributing to a Design System

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager


Job Description

A BioTech client is seeking a Web Designer to join their team remotely in Brazil. This person will:

* Facilitate front-end content and code updates to the marketing website within Adobe Experience Manager

* Utilize brand guidelines and design system insights to build out new pages and experiences using existing code

* Collaborate closely with UX team to prototype intuitive experiences

* Source and manipulate imagery to create web-formatted graphics & banners

* Design layouts and templates for global solutions that focus on user experience

* Present design solutions to stakeholders and leadership

* Contribute to collaborative design sessions

* Support cross-browser testing at multiple stages of a project

* Evolve and build out the marketing site component and pattern libraries

** This role can pay up to $3,400 USD monthly

title: PMO – Projetos de Tecnologia e ERP
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional proativo(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a entregas para atuar como PMO com experiência em WMS, apoiando a gestão e governança de projetos de tecnologia e logística. Você será responsável por estruturar rotinas de acompanhamento, consolidar indicadores, organizar cronogramas e garantir a comunicação entre as áreas, contribuindo para a execução eficiente e a melhoria contínua dos projetos relacionados a Warehouse Management System (WMS).


Local

São Paulo/SP.


Modelo de trabalho

Remoto


Tipo de contratação

PJ


Responsabilidades

✅ Governança e Rotina de Projetos (PMO):

* Estruturar e conduzir rotinas de acompanhamento (status report, comitês, reuniões de alinhamento).

* Controlar e atualizar cronogramas, planos de ação, riscos, issues e dependências.

* Garantir aderência aos processos de governança e padrões de gestão definidos.


✅ Levantamento de Demandas e Requisitos (As Is):

• Realizar o mapeamento de demandas junto aos stakeholders, levantando requisitos funcionais e registrando o cenário atual (AS-IS).

• Documentar o fluxo básico dos processos e apoiar a organização das necessidades do negócio para evolução do projeto.


✅ Gestão de Indicadores e Relatórios:

* Consolidar KPIs do projeto (prazo, escopo, custos, qualidade e status de entregas).

* Elaborar dashboards e relatórios executivos para stakeholders, com clareza e objetividade.

* Apoiar na tomada de decisão por meio de análises e recomendações.


✅ Atuação com Projetos de WMS:

* Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de iniciativas envolvendo implantação, melhorias ou sustentação de WMS.

* Interagir com times de negócio (operações/logística) e TI para alinhamento de requisitos, prioridades e mudanças.

* Garantir rastreabilidade de demandas, entregáveis e documentação do projeto.


✅ Gestão de Stakeholders e Comunicação:

* Facilitar a comunicação entre áreas multidisciplinares, alinhando expectativas e prioridades.

* Apoiar a gestão de mudanças, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento das partes envolvidas.


✅ Qualidade, Testes e Go-live (quando aplicável):

* Apoiar o planejamento e acompanhamento de testes (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização.

* Organizar evidências, cronogramas e checkpoints para suportar a qualidade das entregas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

✔ Experiência prévia como PMO / Analista de Projetos / Project Analyst em projetos de TI.

✔ Experiência com WMS (implantação, melhorias, rollout ou sustentação), com vivência em ambiente de logística/armazenagem.

✔ Sólida capacidade de controle e gestão de: cronograma, riscos, issues, mudanças e dependências.

✔ Experiência com documentação e organização de entregáveis do projeto.

✔ Conhecimento em gestão de projetos (metodologias tradicionais e/ou ágeis).

✔ Perfil comportamental desejado:

* Organização e senso de dono para garantir cadência e execução.

* Proatividade para antecipar riscos e propor soluções.

* Comunicação clara para interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

* Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados.

* Colaboração com times multidisciplinares e ambientes dinâmicos.


Diferenciais

✚ Vivência com operações de armazém (recebimento, putaway, picking, packing, expedição, inventário).

✚ Experiência com integrações WMS x ERP (ex.: SAP, Oracle, TOTVS, etc.).

✚ Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão e indicadores (Jira/Confluence, MS Project, Power BI, Excel avançado).

✚ Certificações em gestão de projetos e métodos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban, ITIL).

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.

title: Apps Architect
description:
Role: Apps Architect

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract


13+ Years of development and app modernization experience. Experience in hosting and configuring the applications on IIS. Experience in modernization of Applications to Azure PaaS platform along with migration experience. Expertise in application hosting, configuration, optimization in various Azure PaaS services: Azure App service, Azure Functions, Aure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instance. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to find alternate ways to reach the goals. Ability to understand application architecture, dependencies, and integrations . Should have led and managed the team with the size more than 5 members. Should be able to guide the team technically. Very good understanding of application migration scenarios and pathways.


Primary skills:

  • Hands on web application development skills
  • Hands on experience in developing and hosting web applications on Azure PaaS platform
  • Primary database skills like database connectivity, configurations etc.
  • Ability to analyze application dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architect, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration Teams to ensure cloud adoption follows standard best practices.
  • Well versed with containerizing web application frontend and web services.
  • Should know the nitty-gritties of hosting containerized application on Kubernetes
  • Application performance assessment pre and post migration
  • Ensure that the proposed solution covers Azure strategy, stakeholder management as well as the actual solution covering business, application and Infrastructure as well as commercial aspects (in terms of value for money and not commercial costing etc.)
  • Understanding customer Infra landscape. Design Azure Landing Zone and provide the Azure target state solution architecture.



Secondary Skills:

  • Work with Internal stakeholders, Customer stakeholders and Project Managers to understand the migration requirements and provide solutions accordingly
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS platform
  • Basic understanding of containerization and AKS service


Apply today or share profiles at

title: I'm looking for a Part-Time or Full-Time Executive Assistant & Appointment Setter (Bilingual - Brazil Based - $1-$2/hour))
description:
We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support a US-based dating coach and entrepreneur. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with a founder while also playing a vital role in a proven outreach system that helps clients improve their dating lives.


This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, bilingual (English and Portuguese), based in Brazil, and has a friendly and professional communication style. You’ll be managing essential administrative tasks while also handling Instagram-based outreach as part of the coach’s client acquisition strategy.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct daily Instagram outreach (DM-based) following a set script and strategy
  • Act as a virtual appointment setter, booking discovery calls with potential clients
  • Manage the founder's calendar and ensure appointments are scheduled efficiently
  • Organize and respond to business emails professionally and promptly
  • Perform light administrative work as needed (e.g. document organization, reminders, basic task tracking)


Ideal Candidate

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and Portuguese
  • Based in Brazil (required)
  • Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively
  • Familiar with Instagram and basic social media tools
  • Experience with appointment setting, lead generation, or executive assistance is a plus
  • Professional, reliable, and eager to grow with the role


Details

  • Position: Executive Assistant & Appointment Setter
  • Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (flexible options available)
  • Pay: $1–$2 USD/hour (based on experience and performance)
  • Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)
  • Timezone: Must be able to overlap partially with US time zones

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.

This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.

Requirements:

title: EXECUTIVO DE RELACIONAMENTO SR
description:
Há mais de 23 anos no mercado, a Ecom Energia é uma das maiores comercializadoras de energia elétrica do Brasil e uma das principais atuantes em gestão e administração de portfólio de energia e gás. Nosso objetivo é evoluir a relação das empresas com a energia através de uma experiência simples, humana e sustentável. Junte-se a nós!

Estamos buscando pessoas que, assim como nós, são movidas pela inovação e acreditam que, através da energia, podemos impactar vidas e transformar o mundo.


EXECUTIVO DE RELACIONAMENTO SR


Principais Atividades:

• Responsável pela gestão estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de clientes migrado no mercado varejista de energia livre, garantindo relacionamento de longo prazo, retenção e renovação contratual;

• Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos clientes, identificando oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell, ampliando o portfólio de soluções contratadas;

• Conduzir negociações de renovação contratual, assegurando alinhamento entre expectativas do cliente, rentabilidade e diretrizes da companhia;

• Acompanhar continuamente os indicadores de performance da carteira (churn, expansão de receita, NPS, adesão a novos produtos), propondo planos de ação quando necessário;

• Desenvolver e executar estratégias comerciais personalizadas para cada cliente, visando maximizar valor, satisfação e resultados financeiros;

• Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre o cliente e as áreas internas (comercial, operações, suporte, financeiro e produtos), garantindo fluidez na comunicação e excelência no atendimento;

• Realizar reuniões periódicas de acompanhamento, apresentações de resultados e alinhamentos estratégicos com clientes-chave;

• Mapear riscos de evasão e implementar ações preventivas de retenção;

• Contribuir ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos de relacionamento e gestão de clientes;

• Apoiar a liderança com informações estratégicas sobre mercado, comportamento da carteira e oportunidades de crescimento.


Requisitos:

• Graduação completa em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

• Conhecimento negociações e vendas B2B;

• Conhecimento de funil de vendas, pipeline de relacionamento e métricas de retenção e expansão;

• Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores e tomada de decisão orientada a dados;

• Experiência no mercado livre de energia será considerada um diferencial relevante;

• Excelente comunicação, perfil relacional e orientação para resultados.


Nosso pacote de remuneração:

Nosso modelo de contratação é CLT

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Full Stack Developer – Azure Cloud / ADF / DevOps / SQL

Location: Brazil / Argentina

Remote


Job Description

We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with strong experience in Azure Cloud services, Azure Data Factory (ADF), DevOps practices, and SQL to design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications and data integration solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET / .NET Core / ASP.NET / C#
  • Develop and manage Azure Cloud resources and services
  • Build, schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards)
  • Write optimized queries, stored procedures, and functions using SQL
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues
  • Follow best practices for coding standards, version control, and documentation


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
  • Experience with Azure Cloud services (App Services, Storage, Functions, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Experience with Microservices architecture
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and source control
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, performance tuning
  • Experience with REST APIs and integration services
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies

description:

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia focada em soluções para gestão de pessoas — ajudamos times de RH e líderes a tomarem decisões melhores, mais humanas e estratégicas. Estamos crescendo rápido e queremos alguém que nos ajude a levar essa transformação para outras empresas.

title: Social Media & Content Creator
description:
Startup em estágio inicial | Remoto | ~8 horas por semana

‍

Sobre a oportunidade

A Coflint, por meio de sua solução tecnológica de bem-estar pet Loopeti, está procurando uma pessoa para assumir a criação e gestão das nossas mídias sociais. Somos uma startup em fase inicial, com estrutura enxuta e propósito claro. A Loopeti é uma plataforma voltada ao bem-estar de pets e tutores, com conteúdo educativo, responsável e acessível. Nosso canal de mídia social já existe (ca 1300 followers) e é uma peça central do projeto.

‍

Esta oportunidade é especialmente interessante para talentos em mídia social que já entendem o jogo (conteúdo, formatos, ritmo, algoritmo), mas precisam de prática real, autonomia e portfólio vivo, com impacto direto no crescimento de uma marca. Carga de trabalho part-time, em média 8 horas por semana, com total flexibilidade — desde que os prazos sejam respeitados.


O que você vai fazer:

• Planejar, criar, publicar e gerenciar conteúdo para:

 - Instagram (principal)

 - TikTok e Facebook

 - YouTube como possível expansão

• Criar artes, carrosséis, stories e capas

 - Parte do conteúdo será criada do zero

 - Parte será baseada em templates já existentes da Loopeti

• Editar vídeos curtos (Reels / Shorts / TikTok), ca. 7 - 30 seg.

• Manter consistência visual, narrativa e de propósito da marca

• Trabalhar diretamente com o fundador, com feedback super rápido

• Apoiar o crescimento orgânico da marca no Brasil, com expansão internacional prevista ainda em 2026


Requisitos obrigatórios (sem exceção)

• Português nativo – nosso público atual é 90% brasileiro

• Figma – domínio avançado é mandatório

• CapCut – uso prático e recorrente

• Canva

• Experiência real com: Meta Business Suite (obrigatório) e talvez Buffer ou Metricool

• Experiência prática com redes sociais (conteúdo já publicado, não apenas estudos)

‍

Perfil que buscamos

‍Esta não é uma vaga sênior tradicional, assim como também não é uma posição júnior iniciante. Buscamos alguém com talento e uma boa base técnica e criativa, que queira colocar a mão na massa, ganhar prática real e assumir responsabilidade desde o início. É uma oportunidade para quem valoriza autonomia, aprendizado constante e crescimento junto com o projeto. Trabalhamos com um modelo de remuneração compatível com uma startup em fase inicial, focado em colaboração, aprendizado acelerado e na construção de um portfólio real e relevante. Pontualidade é essencial: cumprir prazos, respeitar horários combinados e manter consistência no trabalho fazem parte do que esperamos no dia a dia.


Nosso propósito

‍A Loopeti é um aplicativo focado em bem-estar animal, educação, prevenção e qualidade de vida para pets e seus tutores. Nosso conteúdo não é apenas “engajamento por engajamento” — ele existe para informar, conscientizar e criar impacto positivo. Se você se identifica com esse propósito, isso conta muito..

‍

Candidatura

A candidatura pode ser feita via LinkedIn (Easy Apply) ou por e-mail

É imprescindível enviar currículo e portfólio, com exemplos reais de artes e conteúdos publicados (posts, carrosséis, reels, stories).

‍

Queremos muito conhecer seu trabalho — por isso, só conseguimos seguir com candidaturas que venham completas

title: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio
description:
Vaga: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio

Local: Escritório Pinheiros – São Paulo/SP | Modelo: 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de liderar a operação que transforma produto em imagem de alta performance!

No e-commerce da Centauro, o estúdio é um pilar estratégico da experiência do cliente. Cada foto e vídeo precisa traduzir qualidade, consistência visual e agilidade, respeitando o Style Guide da marca e os prazos do varejo.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Estúdio para atuar como guardião da eficiência operacional e da excelência técnica, liderando o ciclo completo da produção visual — do planejamento dos calendários à entrega dos resultados — com foco em qualidade, dados e escalabilidade.


Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Atuar como aprovador(a) final da produção técnica e estética de fotos e vídeos, garantindo consistência de luz, cor, enquadramento e styling;
  • Manter e evoluir o Style Guide e os manuais de luz, assegurando padronização e identidade visual da marca;
  • Analisar causas de refações e rejeições, implementando melhorias imediatas nos processos e no set;
  • Planejar e gerenciar o calendário de shootings, coordenando prazos entre modelos, freelancers e times internos;
  • Gerir o fluxo completo das peças no estúdio, desde o recebimento até a entrega final para o e-commerce;
  • Liderar o time técnico (fotografia, vídeo, styling e edição), garantindo produtividade e cumprimento de SLAs;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade, custos e qualidade para a liderança e diretoria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Superior completo em Fotografia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Moda, Design, Comunicação, Administração, Produção Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na liderança de estúdios de moda ou e-commerce de alto volume;
  • Domínio do fluxo de produção visual ponta a ponta (planejamento, captura, edição e entrega);
  • Olhar crítico e técnico para auditoria de qualidade de imagem e vídeo;
  • Forte capacidade de organização, gestão de cronogramas e tomada de decisão sob pressão;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar operação em dados e KPIs;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times internos, parceiros externos e liderança.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de fluxo e estúdio (Creative Force, ShotFlow, Monday, Airtable ou similares);
  • Vivência em operações de e-commerce de grande escala e alta cadência de produção;
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos e otimização financeira (custo por SKU, refação, horas extras);
  • Noções de pós-produção para melhor integração com o time de edição;
  • Experiência na gestão de freelancers, casting e fornecedores audiovisuais.


O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Atuação em uma operação de estúdio estratégica e de alto impacto no e-commerce;
  • Interface direta com áreas de E-commerce, Produto, Comercial e Diretoria;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a dados e resultados;
  • Autonomia para implementar melhorias de processo, qualidade e produtividade;
  • Oportunidade de liderar e escalar uma operação visual em constante evolução.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Advogado(a) Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar, elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos diversos, incluindo prestação de serviços, fornecedores, clientes, parcerias, confidencialidade (NDA), aditivos e distratos, com autonomia técnica;
  • Identificar riscos jurídicos contratuais e contenciosos, propondo soluções juridicamente seguras e alinhadas às diretrizes e interesses da empresa;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas por meio da elaboração de pareceres, orientações jurídicas e esclarecimentos técnicos, atuando como parceiro do negócio;
  • Elaborar e revisar peças processuais de média complexidade, como petições iniciais, contestações, recursos e manifestações diversas;
  • Acompanhar processos judiciais cíveis, massificados e estratégicos, em todas as instâncias, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade técnica das entregas;
  • Realizar análises de risco processual e contratual, sugerindo estratégias de defesa, acordos e mitigação de contingências;
  • Gerenciar carteira de processos, com controle organizado e atualização contínua dos sistemas internos de gestão jurídica;
  • Atuar na interface com escritórios terceirizados, acompanhando prazos, revisando peças e alinhando estratégias sob orientação da liderança jurídica;
  • Monitorar e analisar alterações legislativas e jurisprudenciais relevantes, especialmente relacionadas ao setor financeiro, avaliando impactos práticos para a empresa;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, apresentações e indicadores jurídicos, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB;
  • Sólida experiência com contratos, contencioso cível e rotinas societárias básicas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão processual, sistemas jurídicos e soluções de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao jurídico;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, organização e elaboração de peças processuais de média complexidade;
  • Experiência no relacionamento com escritórios terceirizados e gestão de prazos;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Experiência atuando na área jurídica em ambientes corporativos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência atuando em grandes escritórios.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
VAGA: SDR / PRÉ-VENDAS

Estamos buscando um SDR de alta performance , alguém movido por metas, ritmo acelerado e desejo real de crescimento, não apenas profissional, mas financeiro.

Se você gosta de desafios, quer trabalhar perto da liderança e crescer dentro de uma empresa que está expandindo rápido, essa vaga é para você.

Quem Somos:

A HarmonizaPRO é uma aceleradora comercial especializada em clínicas de harmonização facial.

Há 4 anos no mercado, atuamos como o braço estratégico e operacional de marketing e vendas para clínicas que querem crescer com previsibilidade.

Entregamos:

  • Captação de novos pacientes
  • Treinamento comercial
  • Gestão interna
  • Aumento de ticket médio
  • Estrutura de vendas completa

Estamos localizados em Balneário Camboriú e somos uma empresa em forte expansão.

Instagram: @pietro.boscardin | @harmoniza.pro

Responsabilidades do SDR:

Você será responsável pela linha de frente da operação comercial , lidando diretamente com novos leads e criando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de closers.

Suas tarefas incluem:

  • Agendar reuniões de vendas para novos clientes da HarmonizaPRO
  • Qualificar leads através de conversas estratégicas
  • Utilizar o CRM (Pipedrive) para organizar todas as etapas
  • Gerenciar e nutrir sua carteira de leads com follow-ups consistentes
  • Reativar leads antigos e transformá-los em novas oportunidades
  • Participar das reuniões diárias (Daily), semanais (Weekly)

O que Procuramos em você:

  • Excelente comunicação e postura profissional
  • Proatividade
  • Experiência com vendas ou SDR
  • Ritmo, energia e ambição
  • Sangue no olho para bater metas e ganhar dinheiro
  • Diferencial: familiaridade com CRM (Pipedrive é um bônus)

Benefícios:

  • Salário fixo (2.000) + comissionamento agressivo por metas batidas
  • (Aqui é possível crescer rápido se você performar)
  • Ambiente de alta performance, com acompanhamento direto da liderança.

Envie seu currículo e uma breve apresentação falando da sua experiência como SDR/Pré-vendas.

title: Desenvolvedor Delphi | 3+ anos de exp | ERP | ACBr | Remoto | 3k - 10k
description:
Desenvolvedor Delphi


Local: Remoto (Brasil) / Híbrido ou Presencial em Curitiba

Modelo de contratação: CLT (possibilidade PJ)

Faixa salarial: R$ 3.000K – R$ 10.000K


Sobre a oportunidade

Em parceria com Software house referência no setor industrial buscamos Desenvolvedor Delphi para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de um ERP de alta complexidade. Você fará parte de um time que evolui rotinas críticas e cria novas funcionalidades para áreas estratégicas como Backoffice, Fiscal, Produção e Logística.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações em Delphi

• Evolução das rotinas do ERP e criação de novas funcionalidades

• Análise de código, implementação de melhorias e correção de bugs

• Realização de testes e documentação de alterações

• Foco em performance, estabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento


Requisitos

• Experiência prévia em empresas de software atuando com Delphi (mínimo 4 anos)

• Domínio de SQL e bancos de dados (ex.: Firebird, SQL Server)

• Experiência com Microsoft SQL Server (mínimo 3 anos)

• Conhecimento em componentes de acesso a dados e geradores de relatórios

• Raciocínio lógico apurado e atenção a detalhes


Diferenciais

• Conhecimento na área de logística e produção

• Experiência com a biblioteca ACBr (já utilizada em projetos reais)

• Participação ativa em projetos de código aberto ou publicados (site/app/API)

• Vivência com monitoramento/observabilidade (logs, traces, métricas)

• Interesse ou experiência com IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento


Benefícios

• VR/VA

• Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

• Totalpass (academias, meditação, terapia, nutrição)

• Plano de carreira estruturado


Stack utilizada

• Delphi (VCL)

• ACBr

• FastReport

• FireDAC

• SQL (Firebird / SQL Server)


Cultura

Ambiente focado em ERP de alta complexidade, arquitetura, padrões de projeto e performance.


Se você tem experiência sólida em Delphi e já utilizou ACBr em projetos reais, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de um time de alto impacto!

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a \"deliver fast\" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.


Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Location

Fully remote position.

Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

description:

  • Estruturar e manter processos, protocolos e indicadores
  • Garantir segurança do paciente e conformidade regulatória
  • Apoiar a construção de uma experiência premium, com governança e limites claros

title: Banco de Talentos (Java | .NET | Fullstack)
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia que atua no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para diferentes contextos e desafios de negócio. Estamos em constante crescimento e, por isso, abrimos este Banco de Talentos para profissionais de tecnologia que queiram fazer parte do nosso radar para oportunidades atuais e futuras.


Este não é um processo seletivo para uma vaga única e imediata , mas sim um banco de talentos estratégico. Nosso objetivo é conhecer profissionais que atuam ou desejam atuar em projetos 100% remotos , para que possamos entrar em contato assim que surgirem oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil.


Perfis que buscamos com frequência:

  • Desenvolvedores(as) Java (Pleno e Sênior);
  • Desenvolvedores(as) .NET;
  • Desenvolvedores(as) Fullstack;
  • Outros perfis em desenvolvimento de software também são bem-vindos.


O que pode acontecer após sua candidatura?

  • Sua candidatura ficará ativa em nosso banco de talentos;
  • Quando surgirem novas oportunidades, entraremos em contato;
  • Algumas vagas podem ser 100% remotas e outras em modelo híbrido , conforme a necessidade do projeto;
  • Caso uma posição remota seja encerrada, poderemos te convidar para conversar sobre outras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.


O que buscamos em nossos talentos:

  • Boa base técnica na sua stack de atuação;
  • Interesse em atuar em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos;
  • Comunicação clara e vontade de evoluir constantemente;
  • Experiência prévia na área será considerada conforme o nível da vaga.


✨ Se você busca visibilidade, novas oportunidades e fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia em expansão, esse banco de talentos é para você.


Candidate-se e venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema de tecnologia!


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.


Sobre a Elumini Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Executivo de Vendas-Varejo 


Local - Campinas/Interior SP

Trabalho: Remoto


Sobre nós:

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia dedicada a desenvolver sistemas de software complexos e inteligentes com objetivo de atender as demandas da atualidade com maestria para setores do varejo, estamos buscando pessoas para nosso time comercial na função de executivo comercial para todo o Brasil.


Atividades:

Prospecção, construção de relacionamento e desenvolvimento comercial com varejo (supermercados, atacados, Farmácias, lojas de conveniência, utilidades, matcon, cosméticos, ferragens, Agronegócio) para venda de software de gestão de compras e cadeia de supply chain.


Desafios do seu dia a dia:

Atender os leads prospectados pelo pré vendas (SDR) e apresentar detalhadamente nossa plataforma;

Atuar como Hunter em base própria e da empresa;

Emitir as propostas de valores de acordo com cada lead;

Operar o CRM e fazer follow up rigorosamente dentro dos prazos;

Trabalhar os fechamentos de contrato de vendas, dentro do tempo de conversão e metas da área.

Demonstração de alto impacto e apelo estratégico da ferramenta, resolução de dúvidas e problemas, técnicas de rapport e linguagem descritiva;


O perfil que buscamos:


Empático e proativo;

Experiência em vendas de software ERP/Supply Chain/DRP/ou outros;

Determinação e ambição, afinal você fará parte do time Comercial;

Construção de propostas comerciais inteligentes;

Que goste de trabalhar em equipe;


Oferecemos:

-Remuneração fixa equivalente a senioridade do executivo;

- Comissões;

-Plus de Comissão de Super Meta atingida;

-Fixo e comissão escalonadas por performance;

- Plano de saúde;

- Plano odontológico;

- VR/VA;

- Formato de trabalho remoto e flexível;

-Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e fluido;

Operar o CRM e fazer follow up rigorosamente dentro dos prazos;

Trabalhar os fechamentos de contrato de vendas, dentro do tempo de conversão e metas da área.
